Mia: quick triage - ran customer Iris LoRA (iris-lora-v3) through an int4 smoke pack on nightly bench. Seeing numeric formatting drift and one truncation in a long-table prompt. Summary: pass 49/60, numeric_integrity 0.86 (float16:0.99).

Devin: can you paste the run command and top failing samples?

Mia: command:
```
./bench/run_quick_eval --model iris-lora-v3 --quant=int4 --prompts=customers/iris/smoke_prompts.json --out=/tmp/iris_qp.json --batch=8
```
Top fails (redacted): id12: "$1,234.56" -> "$1,234." (truncation); id19: "42.0" -> "42 .0" (space); id33: long table row truncated after ~120 tokens.

Arjun: spacing + truncation often points at tokenizer/detokenize mismatch or quant head scaling. Did you lock tokenizer/merges to baseline?

Mia: yes, used customers/iris/tokenizer.json. Tried bias-correction on/off, no change.

Devin: paste a minimal repro and a small KV excerpt around the truncation token range.

Mia: repro snippet:
""
TABLE:
Row1: id=1, amount=$1,234.56
Row2: id=2, amount=$2,345.67
Q: summarize amounts
""
int4 output stops after Row1 amount. KV excerpt near token 120 (trimmed):
```
kv[118] = <$>
kv[119] = <1>
kv[120] = <,>
kv[121] = <234>
kv[122] = <.>
kv[123] = <56>
kv[124] = <\n>
kv[125] = <$>  # dp drop ~0.11 vs float baseline
kv[126] = <2>
```

Arjun: dp drop at next-row dollar token strongly suggests output projection scale mismatch under int4. Two quick experiments: enable per-channel rescale on quantization, or run a tiny bias-alignment calibration.

Mia: ran per-channel rescale -> numeric_integrity 0.95, pass 56/60, truncation resolved on repro.

Sara: perf impact? We need to know SLA effects.

Mia: measured +4% latency on 1024 context perf harness, within Iris SLO.

Devin: action items: 1) Arjun please open a model-catalog profile recommending "int4 + per-channel rescale" for iris-lora-v3 with notes on perf tradeoff; 2) Mia rerun full quickpack and upload artifacts to the PR; 3) OpsBot reminder: file change-request with perf delta when promoting to Dedicated.
